      "source": "import os\nfrom galileo.otel import GalileoSpanProcessor, add_galileo_span_processor\nfrom opentelemetry import trace\nfrom opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider\nfrom opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import BatchSpanProcessor\nfrom opentelemetry.exporter.otlp.proto.http.trace_exporter import OTLPSpanExporter\nprovider=TracerProvider()\nadd_galileo_span_processor(provider, GalileoSpanProcessor(project=os.getenv(\"GALILEO_PROJECT\")))\nprovider.add_span_processor(BatchSpanProcessor(OTLPSpanExporter(endpoint=os.environ[\"INTERNAL_TRACE_ENDPOINT\"])))\ntrace.set_tracer_provider(provider)\ndef run_agent(client, messages, tools):\n    while True:\n        response = client.complete(messages=messages, tools=list(tools))\n        messages.append(response.message)\n        if not response.tool_calls:\n            return response.text\n        for call in response.tool_calls:\n            result = tools[call.name](**call.arguments)\n            messages.append({\"role\": \"tool\", \"tool_call_id\": call.id, \"content\": result})\n",
